shareholders.data_date_basis: Profil IDX tidak mencantumkan tanggal posisi; angka ini adalah susunan pemegang saham terakhir yang dilaporkan emiten ke IDX. Laporan Bulanan Registrasi Pemegang Efek terbaru BBCA terbit di IDX 2026-09-09 (No. 013/CSG-IVR/2026, posisi akhir Agustus 2026); PDF-nya belum dibaca untuk memastikan tanggal posisi.
shareholders.free_float_basis: Masyarakat (warkat 2,508% + non warkat 42,134%) = 44,642% saham tercatat; tidak termasuk pengendali, saham treasuri (0,351%) serta direksi dan komisaris (~0,06%). BCA mencatat, per 31 Desember 2025, sebagian porsi publik dimiliki pihak terafiliasi PT Dwimuria Investama Andalan (lihat corroboration.note), jadi angka ini adalah kategori kepemilikan publik IDX, bukan free float yang disesuaikan untuk afiliasi.

corroboration.source_title: BCA, Investor Relations: Composition of Shareholders

public.includes: saham treasuri 0,17% serta direksi dan komisaris 0,062%

corroboration.note: Halaman BCA: dari porsi publik per 31 Desember 2025, '49%' dimiliki pihak terafiliasi PT Dwimuria Investama Andalan (angka sebagaimana tertulis); pemilik akhir Dwimuria adalah Robert Budi Hartono dan Bambang Hartono.

actions.description: Net treasury shares acquired in 1H26 (262.016.800 -> 433.298.700) under the buyback programmes disclosed in Catatan 1b; the issuer gives no per-date split.

notes: The 12 March 2026 - 11 March 2027 buyback programme is still open; the IDX profile count of 24 September 2026 shows no change after 30 June.

normalization_ledger.policy: One-off: gains or losses on disposal of investments, investment property or fixed assets, fixed-asset write-offs, fair-value gains or losses on investments, tax penalties, reversals of prior-period accruals, and net foreign-exchange gains or losses (the forecast does not project exchange movements). Recurring: operating other income (rent, penalties charged, insurance claims, scrap and by-product sales), inventory provisions and expected-credit-loss movements on operating receivables. Tax effect at the 22% statutory rate unless the item is non-deductible; the minority effect is the group's non-controlling share of profit where the entity bearing the item is not disclosed. An undisclosed composite line of 5% or more of period attributable earnings (release policy 1.2.0 materiality) blocks affirmative review.
normalization_ledger.scope_note: FY2025 and earlier are not assessed in this ledger; the forecast's first year uses the 1H26 actual plus a modelled second half, so the 1H26 bridge is the one that reaches FY1.
